styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Vieux Lyon, the basilica and the traboules.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Bouchons, markets and the Halles de Lyon.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Roman Lugdunum, silk trade and the Resistance.

stays.why: Between the two rivers. Walk to Vieux Lyon, the shops and most restaurants. Best all-round base.
Cobbled lanes, traboules and the funicular up to Fourvière. Quiet at night, touristy by day.
The old silk-workers' hill. Village feel, markets and views. Steep walks down to the centre.
Business district by the main train station and airport bus. Handy for day trips, less charming.

food: Try a bouchon: small Lyonnais restaurants serving quenelles, andouillette and salade lyonnaise. Book ahead for dinner.
Les Halles de Lyon Paul Bocuse is the covered food market. Go hungry, taste cheese and charcuterie, and eat lunch at a counter.
Order local dishes: pike quenelle, rosette de Lyon sausage, and praline tart for dessert.
Cheap eats: a sandwich or kebab in Presqu'île, or a slice of pizza near the university, roughly €8–15.
Lunch menus (formule) are much cheaper than dinner. Expect about €18–30 at a mid-range bouchon.
more_time: Add a half-day in the Beaujolais vineyards south of the city. Check tours and train times on the day.
Day trip to Annecy or Grenoble by train for lakes and mountains. Book seats in advance.
Spend a morning at the Musée des Confluences, then walk the riverside parks.

recommend.why: Two nights covers Vieux Lyon, Fourvière and a proper bouchon dinner. Add a night for museums and a day trip.

month_notes: January: cold, highs near 7°C, rain on about 13 days. Pack a warm coat and waterproof shoes.
February: still cold but drier, around 8 rain days. Good for museums and indoor sights.
March: milder, highs near 13°C, about 11 rain days. Bring layers and an umbrella.
April: pleasant at around 17°C. Showers possible; good for walking the old town.
May: warm, highs near 20°C, but rain on about 13 days. Keep a light rain jacket.
June: warm and mostly dry, highs near 26°C. Long evenings for riverside walks.
July: hottest month, highs near 28°C, only about 8 rain days. Book restaurants ahead.
August: hot like July, about 7 rain days. Some small shops close for holidays; check on the day.
September: warm and dry, highs near 23°C. One of the best months to visit.
October: cooler at around 18°C, about 9 rain days. Good light for photos and fewer crowds.
November: chilly, highs near 11°C, rain on about 12 days. Plan indoor backup.
December: cold, highs near 8°C, about 12 rain days. Christmas markets and warm cafés.

climate_guide.summary: Semi-continental climate: warm to hot summers, cold winters, and rain spread across the year.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Warm days around 20–28°C. July and August are hottest and driest.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 7–13 rain days every month. May and January are wettest; August is driest.

items.title: Cold winters
items.text: December to February highs near 7–8°C and lows near 1–2°C. Bring a warm coat.

items.title: Hot summer afternoons
items.text: July and August reach about 28°C. Sightsee in the morning and rest in the shade at midday.

items.title: Mild spring and autumn
items.text: April, May, September and October are comfortable for walking, with highs of 17–23°C.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers, a waterproof jacket and comfortable shoes for cobbles. Add a hat and sunscreen for summer.

transit.best: Metro and walking for the centre; tap a bank card and go.

modes.text: Lines A–D plus two funiculars run about 05:00–00:00. Fastest way between the centre, the station and Fourvière.
Five tram lines link the centre, campuses and suburbs.
Buses cover the city, but some stop after 21:00. Check the last bus on the day.
Taxis and apps like Uber and Bolt work. Taxis wait at stations and the airport.
Not needed in the centre. Parking is tight; use transit instead.
The centre is walkable. Vélo'v bikes and the Navigône ferry help on nice days.
The Navigône river ferry crosses the Saône on nice days. Check times on the day.
